jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: The Missing Lid
seedTermsUsed: Taking advice from the wrong person
jokes.joke: I took a pottery class. The guy beside me said, “The secret is more speed,” so I cranked the wheel. My bowl launched across the room and landed upside down on his. Turns out he wasn’t the instructor—he’d just been waiting for someone to make him a lid.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Glass Half Empty
seedTermsUsed: Taking advice from the wrong person
jokes.joke: I told my buddy I wanted to try a relaxing new hobby, so he suggested glassblowing. Guy's never done it either. First day, I'm holding a five-foot pipe with molten glass on the end, and he yells, 'Just blow harder if it's not working!' Twenty minutes later I'm in the ER and the doctor asks what happened. I said, 'I trusted a guy whose only craft experience was blowing up pool floats.'

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: The Getaway
jokes.joke: I recently pulled off a high-stakes bank caper. Flawless execution. Unfortunately, our getaway van got towed, so my crew had to take the subway. Let me tell you, the adrenaline of a heist really fades when you're standing on a local platform for forty minutes holding canvas sacks with giant dollar signs on them. When the cops finally found us, they didn't even yell 'Freeze!' They just drew their weapons and ordered us to let the passengers off first.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Subway Stranger Advice
seedTermsUsed: Taking advice from the wrong person
jokes.joke: You ever catch yourself taking advice from the wrong person? Yesterday I'm standing on the subway platform, late for a meeting, and this guy with a giant map tattoo says, 'Take the local, it's more reliable.' I hop on like an idiot. Forty minutes later we're stalled in the tunnel, lights flickering, AC dead. I'm dripping sweat, missing my stop, and the whole car smells like defeat. Why do I talk to people?

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Tunnel Wisdom
seedTermsUsed: Taking advice from the wrong person
jokes.joke: I once took advice from a guy in a subway tunnel who looked like he’d been down there since the last renovation. He told me, “If you miss your train, just chase it. Shows initiative.” So there I am sprinting after a departing car like it’s a job interview on wheels, and the conductor’s staring at me like, “Buddy, this is not how ambition works.”
